thesis: Power can genuinely fascinate without acquiring legitimacy; collective coordination need not imply domination.

ideas.statement: Spectacle can convert visible capacity into a claim to obedience, masking the gap between appearing in a collective and deciding its purposes.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Benjamin’s historical critique does not condemn every ceremony; hypothetical grandeur and charm mechanisms are not universal laws, and apparent confidence can rely on others absorbing costs.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Benjamin’s historical critique does not condemn every ceremony; hypothetical grandeur and charm mechanisms are not universal laws, and apparent confidence can rely on others absorbing costs.

audit.notes: Direct active-LLM all-unit analysis; distinct values and qualifications preserved.
